_comment: Known layer-boundary violations that are accepted for now, recorded so
CI can distinguish 'we already knew about this one' from 'someone just
live import graph with STRICT EQUALITY. It fails in both directions:
- a violation present here but no longer in the code  -> remove it
- a violation in the code but not present here         -> fix it, do not
So this file can only shrink. Every entry names the refactor phase that
removes it; when a phase is merged, delete its entries in the same commit.
